notes: Implemented Phase 3 of Change Requests Implementation Plan (CR-08, CR-01, CR-04a, CR-04b, CR-04c). CR-01: Extended diagonal slice angle slider from 0-75 to -75 to 75 — math already supported negative angles via Math.tan(). CR-04b: Added hexSizeMultiplier parameter to HexagonalLayout.js with passthrough through LayoutGenerator and LayoutManager. Added Hexagon Size slider (50%-200%) in UI. CR-08: Restructured right sidebar into 6 collapsible sections (Layout, Title, Crop, Background, Overlay, Export) with chevron indicators, aria-expanded attributes, and auto-expand crop on panel selection. CR-04a: Created CropOverlayShape.js with pure computeShapeOverlayPoints() and drawShapeOverlay() functions for drawing shaped overlays on crop preview canvas. CR-04c: Created HexPanelSwap.js with swapPanelAssignments() pure function and createHexDragHandler() for hexagonal panel drag-and-drop with undo support. Fixed 3 bugs from world-review: (1) Event listener cleanup failure in GestureHandler/CropInteraction/HexPanelSwap — arrow function wrappers prevent removeEventListener from matching; fixed with late-bound handler pattern. (2) GestureHandler/HexDragHandler coordination — added hexagonal layout skip in GestureHandler._onPointerDown to prevent double-firing. (3) Added proper detach() call for HexDragHandler in beforeUnmount. All 953 tests pass (1 pre-existing failure in SaliencyDebugOverlayTest.html unrelated).
